457006.overview:
Mouse/keyboard card game.

A standard pack of 52 cards are used for the game. 12 cards are dealt to the SPARE pile on the right of the screen and 4 cards are dealt as the first cards of the TABLEAUX in the centre of the screen. The remainder of the pack form the main playing cards of the game.

A card can be taken from the main pack and put onto the tableaux as long as the card is 1 value lower and of a different colour to the card it is placed on. The same can be done from the spare pile. The piles from the tableaux can also be move from stack to stack either singly or in a block. Aces can be followed by kings when doing this. 

Above the tableaux are 4 spaces on which the suits are built. A card is placed in position 1 at the start of the game, and all 4 suit stacks must be started with a card of the same value. After which, cards may be added to these stacks from the main cards, the spare cards or the tableaux card as long as they are built in ascending order of the same suit. In this instance an ace may be placed upon a king. 

The main cards are dealt 1 at a time by clicking on the face down pack, which when empty can be re-dealt by clicking on the blank space. The spare cards on the right cannot be dealt, and only the top face up card can be used in play. 

To move any card simply click on it and then where you wish to move it to.
The game is complete when all the cards have been moved to the fop suit piles.
